description: This Java class 'UrlServletHelper' provides utility methods for handling URL-related operations within the OFBiz framework, including setting request attributes, managing path aliases, and sanitizing strings for URL use.

classes.name: UrlServletHelper
classes.description: Utility class for URL handling in OFBiz, including setting request attributes, managing URL path aliases, and sanitizing strings for URL safety.

methods.name: setRequestAttributes
methods.description: Sets request attributes such as delegator, servlet context, and webSiteId, handling multi-tenant scenarios.

methods.name: setViewQueryParameters
methods.description: Extracts view-related query parameters from the request URL and appends them to a URL builder, also setting request attributes.

methods.name: checkPathAlias
methods.description: Checks if the request path matches a URL alias and forwards or returns 404 accordingly.

methods.name: invalidCharacter
methods.description: Sanitizes a string by replacing special characters with hyphens for URL safety.
